package control_flow_graph
import "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
var adamicDecoratorObserve bool
var adamicDecoratorDepth int
var adamicDecoratorCalls []*ast.Node
func (b *Builder[E]) expr(node *ast.Node) {
    if adamicDecoratorObserve && adamicDecoratorDepth == 0 { adamicDecoratorCalls = append(adamicDecoratorCalls, node) }
    adamicDecoratorDepth++
    b.adamicOriginalExpr(node)
    adamicDecoratorDepth--
}
func AdamicDecoratorCalls(node *ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
    b := &Builder[int]{}
    b.cur = b.newBlock()
    b.cur.hasIncoming = true
    b.cur.Reachable = true
    adamicDecoratorCalls = nil
    adamicDecoratorDepth = 0
    adamicDecoratorObserve = true
    b.decorators(node)
    adamicDecoratorObserve = false
    return adamicDecoratorCalls
}
